Devoted to Brahman and truth. After his encounter with the Asuras on behalf of Indra, he wanted rest and the celestials allowed him to sleep undisturbed, adding that whoever dis- turbed him, would be burnt to death. So he slept in a cave where कृष्ण led his Yavana foe (कालयवन) who disturbing Mucukunda's sleep was burnt to death. Soon कृष्ण appeared before him and informed him of his अवतार् and its purpose. Mucukunda's praise of कृष्ण and request of union with Him. कृष्ण replied that he had to undergo still one more birth as a धर्मिच् Brahmana and then reach Him. Taking leave of the Lord, he saw the advent of Kali and entered गन्धमादन. He worshipped Hari in the बदरी a1s4rama by तपस्।
